title: FatterVerse
tagline: Every AI conversation becomes a star. Related work forms constellations.
what: A live 3D galaxy of my AI work. Every conversation is a star, related work gathers into constellations, plans and work paths run through them, and new sessions flare into view while the page is open.
built: Turned every session and summary into a star, including older sessions with no observation records
Streamed new work into every open browser and made newborn sessions flare without a reload
Laid the galaxy out nightly by meaning, named the clusters and drew plans and work paths through them
Added a wall-display mode and a time-lapse replay of the galaxy growing
starring: Every AI conversation I have had
progress: The live galaxy, semantic layout, work overlays, wall mode and replay are all running.

remix.changed: Built the live corpus, streaming bridge, semantic layout, plans, work paths, star births, wall mode and replay on top.

making.problem: Thousands of AI conversations were useful one at a time but impossible to see as one body of work. I wanted to stand back and see what kept connecting.
how: A bridge turns each saved conversation and summary into one star
Related conversations pull together in a nightly three-dimensional layout
Plans, work paths and named clusters draw the shape around those stars
A live event stream adds new stars and flares them in every open browser

broke.title: The galaxy outgrew one big snapshot
broke.body: I changed the 299 MB snapshot from three copies in memory to a stream, and the next nightly layout finished cleanly at a 75 MB peak.

credits: Constellate by JCarterJohnson is the MIT-licensed visual foundation
Live corpus, bridge, layout, work structure and effects by me

moment.what: I can start a new session, keep the galaxy open on the wall and watch its new star flare into view about 35 seconds later.

b: About 35 seconds to a new star
